title: Prove retained landing capture in Node Vitest

intentCoverage.report:
**Verdict. Caught.** The maintained launch-record assertion failed because the stored revision was the fetched trunk tip, while the accepted merge was a different commit.

**Next proof action.** None for this promise on the observed Story Branch merge path. The existing record match already fails when that stored revision is the trunk tip.

**Story and revision.** SEED-413#landing-capture-evidence-via-vitest, `.planning/seeds/SEED-413-renovate-dashboard-unit-tests.md#landing-capture-evidence-via-vitest`, plan `.planning/slice-plans/864-prove-landing-capture-evidence-on-vitest/PLAN.md`, at `079e46bf6b7d47136c435480541b9b8decd2cc29`.

**Promise.** The comparison used for a launch is the work origin accepted for that launch. After the specs moved, a Story Branch integration still records the fetched trunk tip and the accepted merge, and refuses a candidate that is not that accepted commit.

**Fault.** The suggested record-path fault held, and its location was revised once. A first edit in `decideRetainedLanding` (`dashboard/server/retainedLandingDecision.ts`) stored `revision: landing.base`. That edit was present in a freshly built server bundle, and the same focused case still passed, so that write was not the record this journey stored. That file was restored to its pre-probe bytes. The single fault then placed in `dashboard/server/attemptLandingDecision.ts`, in the record update passed to `changeBoundLandingRecord`, replaced `{ landing }` with `{ landing: { ...landing, revision: landing.base } }`. Fixtures and assertions were left intact. The receipt returned to the publisher stayed the verified landing, so publication still named the accepted commit, while the saved launch record stored the comparison base.

**Scratch checkout.** `/Users/terryyin/git/open-dough/.scratch/intent-coverage-landing-079e46bf`, detached at `079e46bf6b7d47136c435480541b9b8decd2cc29`. Pre-probe `git status --porcelain` was empty. The execution checkout was not edited. Node was 24.21.0 from `/opt/homebrew/bin`, and `PATH` started with `/opt/homebrew/bin`.

**Maintained check.** The same command before the fault, with the fault, and after restoration:

```sh
PATH="/opt/homebrew/bin:$PATH" caffeinate -s -i npm run test:e2e -- e2e/review/story-branch-landing-capture.spec.ts --grep "records the fetched trunk tip and the accepted merge" --workers=1
```

The quiet reporter prints nothing on a pass. Playwright exits non-zero when the grep matches nothing. Baseline exit 0 in 13.12 s, and the later failure names the one case whose title starts "records the fetched trunk tip and the accepted merge" (`e2e/review/story-branch-landing-capture.spec.ts:55`).

**Reach and wrong behavior.** With the attempt-path fault the case failed at `expect(landed.landing).toMatchObject(...)` in `e2e/review/story-branch-landing-capture.spec.ts:113`. Reaching that line means the earlier expects passed: the non-HEAD candidate was refused, the integration published one merge whose first parent was the fetched trunk tip and whose second parent was the story tip, and the publisher receipt matched `revision: accepted`. The stored record then differed only in `revision`: expected the accepted merge `b0d94ac18003ba19b9f1320692bb822aaf1ae1f7`, received `b198079ee97592818e303e445af8084d3c2ca2f2`. `base: trunkTip` still matched, and the fault assigns that base to `revision`, so the saved revision was the fetched trunk tip.

**Restoration.** `git checkout -- dashboard/server/attemptLandingDecision.ts` returned the scratch tree to an empty `git status --porcelain` at the same HEAD. `retainedLandingDecision.ts` still hashed to its pre-probe digest `44ecf30eca40a056d6b2bdfe07133b985e8ee3b7a92732ad9ec072f19018902c`. The same command then passed, exit 0. The scratch checkout was left clean.

**Costs.**

- **Test runtime.** Measured by `/usr/bin/time -p` real time, which includes npm and Playwright startup. The quiet reporter did not print its own duration. Baseline 13.12 s, exit 0. Discarded retained-path edit 6.43 s, exit 0. Catching run 4.41 s, exit 1. Restored run 5.49 s, exit 0. The baseline, catching, and restored runs sum to 23.02 s.
- **Human effort.** Unavailable. No separate human-effort measure was recorded for this probe.
- **Agent effort.** Unavailable. No separate agent-effort measure was supplied.


- **Invocation-to-report elapsed.** 1259703 ms (measured), from 1795861393068 to 1795862652771 in Unix epoch ms. The end clock was sampled after writing the prepared report body.

Disposition: 079e46bf6b7d47136c435480541b9b8decd2cc29, Caught, no follow-up.
